json.take: Before we blindly trust the model's preference for an extra pass, we need to ask what assumptions it makes about the defense not collapsing that passing lane in real time. In fast transitions, theoretical options vanish instantly, making Bastian Sandoval's immediate strike the only guaranteed attempt on goal.
